end.summary:
Discussed ants, earthworms, beetles, and millipedes as soil animals.
Pihu shared observations of ants carrying food and an earthworm in a compost pit.
Practised observing soil animals under wet leaves using a stick.
Pihu asked questions about earthworms, soil, and safe observation; the earthworm-soil mix-up was not corrected.
Teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Pihu practised naming soil animals and describing where they may be found, using observation under wet leaves. They shared clear observations about ants and an earthworm and asked questions about whether earthworms harm soil. The idea that earthworms make soil worse was not corrected during the lesson. At home, look at a picture or short book about earthworms and discuss how they help soil, without handling animals directly.
